title: Nyc South Asian Comedy Festival Roast Battle – India Vs Pakistan Vs Bangladesh Vs Sri Lanka.
description: Experience the Laughter Riot at NYC South Asian Comedy Festival Roast Battle
long_description:
Experience the Laughter Riot at NYC South Asian Comedy Festival Roast Battle
Mark your calendars for October 17th, 2026, for an unforgettable night of laughter and fun at the NYC South Asian Comedy Festival Roast Battle – India Vs Pakistan Vs Bangladesh Vs Sri Lanka. This grand event, organised by Laughing Lassi (LaughingLassi), promises an evening filled with Hindi comedy and music. The show is set to take place at the lively Broadway Comedy Club, Red Room, attracting comedy lovers from all corners of the world.
Meet the Laughter Maestro - Ali Mehedi
We are thrilled to introduce the star of the show – Ali Mehedi. This talented comedian, renowned for his light-hearted humor and engaging performances, has graced the stages of Absolute Comedy Club and Yuk Yuk's Comedy Club in Toronto, Gotham Comedy Club, Carolines on Broadway, New York Comedy Club, and Standup NY. Ali's unique comedic style and charismatic stage presence captivate audiences, promising a night filled with laughter, cheer, and entertainment.
Discover the Broadway Comedy Club, Red Room
Located in the heart of New York City, at 318 W 53rd St, NY, United States, Broadway Comedy Club, Red Room, is the perfect venue for this extraordinary event. Known for its safe and accessible location, this comedy hub is surrounded by a plethora of attractions. After laughing your hearts out at the show, consider dining at one of the nearby Indian restaurants, serving authentic, mouth-watering cuisine. Parking facilities are conveniently available in the vicinity, ensuring an enjoyable and hassle-free experience for all.
Secure Your Seats Today!
Be part of this laughter extravaganza by booking your tickets today! Offering standard Red Room tickets at $25.00, you won't want to miss out on this opportunity to immerse yourself in a night filled with comedy and music. Hurry, as tickets are selling out fast!
